meta.title: JetBrains IDE MCP connections
meta.description: Multi-connection manager that connects DSH to the MCP servers built into JetBrains IDEs, so the agent sees each IDE's inspections, builds, symbol analysis and run configurations instead of a disk-only view. One connection per IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, CLion, PyCharm); each mounts its own MCP client and exposes mcp__<serverName>__* tools.
